title: Console sidebar in icon-rail mode: entries of a collapsed nav group (Account → Developer, Setup → Advanced) are not reachable at all
body:
qa#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AecbS6JEeLdRWSW4AC

Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced on a public entry (reach below).

QA-source: #32135 · platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render · observed beside the clauses
Batch-of: objectstack-ai/objectstack#32135 follow-ups, 15 cards filed on the maintainer's 「立卡处理」

## What we saw

Reach: the console at a 1360 px window, where the sidebar opens as an icon rail (the narrow-window behaviour #27593 introduced). Groups the app declares `expanded: false` (Account → Developer: API Keys, OAuth Applications; Setup → Advanced) contribute no icons to the rail and offer no flyout, so their entries can only be reached by opening the sidebar overlay and expanding the group, or by typing the URL.

## Proposed change

In rail mode, a collapsed group shows a group icon that opens a flyout with its entries (or the rail lists the group's entries regardless of the expanded flag).

## Business reason

Who: every user on a laptop-width window. Cost: features such as API keys look absent.

## Reader

Triage first touch; lands in `ui/` (app-shell sidebar rail).

## Duplicate check

`is:issue repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack sidebar rail collapsed default` (17, open and closed): #27593 (rail on narrow windows, closed) and #25876 (child count on collapsed groups, closed) do not cover reachability in the rail.
